svg.title: smlibpy — The Art of Modelling in Python
svg.desc: Frontispiece: an engineering drawing of the pipe flange of examples/flange.py — section A–A, the view from the left and the plan in first-angle projection, dimensioned, with a title block that gives the volume smlibpy measures. Title page: smlib·py, or, the Art of Modelling in Python — wherein the SMLib kernel is given to Python: to build exact parts from short scripts, to draw what it has built, and to prove the work in numbers. In four parts: the library, the renderer, the MCP server, the skill. MMXXVI.
